# Overview

# This notebook analyzes hippocampal task-related neural activity during episodic memory encoding across healthy controls and individuals with opioid use disorder, including participants with and without a history of non-fatal opioid overdose.

# Participant-level data are not included in this repository.

# Data Preparation

## Load packages

library(car)
library(emmeans)
library(effectsize)
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(openxlsx)
library(ggbeeswarm)

options(pillar.sigfig = 6)


## Load data

# Set this to the location of the dataset.
# data_path <- "/path/to/data.xlsx"


dat <- read.xlsx(
  data_path,
  sheet = "NA",
  na.strings = "NA"
)

## Define variables

dat <- dat %>%
  mutate(
    Subject_ID = as.factor(Subject_ID),
    Grp = factor(
      Grp,
      levels = c("HC", "OUD-NOD", "OUD-OD", "OUD (other)")
    ),
    Grp_OUD_All = factor(
      Grp_OUD_All,
      levels = c("HC", "OUD")
    ),
    Sex = as.factor(Sex),
    Race = factor(
      Race,
      levels = c("White", "Black", "Asian", "Other")
    ),
    Ethnicity = factor(
      Ethnicity,
      levels = c("Hispanic", "Non-Hispanic")
    ),
    Medication = factor(
      Medication,
      levels = c("Methadone", "Buprenorphine", "No medication")
    )
  )


# Hippocampal Neural Activity

## Analysis Dataset


hpc_dat <- dat %>%
  filter(
    Study == "Tau",
    Grp != "OUD (other)"
  ) %>%
  droplevels()


## Bilateral Hippocampal Activity

The primary analysis examined bilateral hippocampal task-related activity (`BiHPC_task`) across healthy controls, OUD without a history of non-fatal overdose, and OUD with a history of non-fatal overdose.


hpc_model <- lm(
  BiHPC_task ~ Grp,
  data = hpc_dat
)


### Omnibus Group Test


hpc_anova <- car::Anova(
  hpc_model,
  type = 3
)

hpc_anova


### Effect Size


hpc_effect <- effectsize::eta_squared(
  hpc_anova,
  partial = TRUE
)

hpc_effect


### Estimated Marginal Means


hpc_emmeans <- emmeans(
  hpc_model,
  ~ Grp
)

hpc_emmeans



# Figure Generation

The primary figure displays bilateral hippocampal task-related activity across groups.


hpc_plot <- ggplot(
  hpc_dat,
  aes(x = Grp, y = BiHPC_task)
) +
  geom_boxplot(
    aes(color = Grp),
    width = 0.5,
    linewidth = 1,
    outlier.shape = NA
  ) +
  stat_boxplot(
    geom = "errorbar",
    aes(color = Grp),
    width = 0.5,
    linewidth = 1
  ) +
  geom_jitter(
    width = 0.08,
    height = 0,
    alpha = 0.7
  ) +
  theme_linedraw() +
  labs(
    x = NULL,
    y = "Hippocampal activity",
    title = "Hippocampal Neural Activity During Memory Encoding"
  ) +
  guides(color = "none") +
  theme(
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 12),
    plot.title = element_text(
      size = 14,
      face = "bold",
      hjust = 0.5
    )
  )

hpc_plot


# Save figure

ggsave(
  "Figures/Hippocampal_Activity.png",
  plot = hpc_plot,
  width = 6,
  height = 5,
  dpi = 300
)


# Summary

The analysis examined bilateral hippocampal task-related neural activity during successful episodic memory encoding across healthy controls, OUD without a history of non-fatal overdose, and OUD with a history of non-fatal overdose.

The primary outcome was `BiHPC_task`, representing bilateral hippocampal activity for the remembered > forgotten contrast.

Participant-level data are excluded from this repository.
